method: Two independent critics started with fresh context, reference image, candidate render, and user constraints. Subsequent revisions were re-reviewed by the same critics.
constraints: Keep center island geometry, props, transforms, and materials unchanged.
Use approved connected rock terrain style, not concept blockwork.

critic_a.assessment: Rear destination resolved, rooms readable, workshop glare and occlusions corrected. No blocking readability defects.
residuals: Bridge grades remain steeper than concept
Cool atmospheric illumination remains more uniform than concept

critic_b.assessment: Rear bridge destination and workshop warmth resolved. Coherent and readable composition ready under preservation constraints.
residuals: More selective shadows on lower supports could further deepen the abyss
